title: Uses previous tier hover names the tier it follows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, with its own rule 10% off in matrix A.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, the next tier after tier A, on Same as previous tier in matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Point at a cell in tier B's column.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.
  • Tier B's cells read Uses previous tier.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip reads "Uses previous tier," tier A's number, " · " and tier A's name, ending with a full stop.
